title: CHG-9625: Data Lake Ingest change memo
body:
Summary

This memo records a change to the Data Lake Ingest that is currently pending. It was raised by Rohan Mehta of Data Services and touches 19 hosts behind the Data Lake Ingest, all of them in the production estate.

Details

Steps scheduled in the 22:00-23:30 UTC window with support from Northwind Systems:
- Rotate the database credentials used by the nightly batch jobs
- Enable TLS 1.3 on the internal load balancer listeners
- Switch alert delivery from email to the paging service

Decision

Board outcome for CHG-9625: pending. Victor Nwosu filed this record on 28 November 2025 after the board session of 12 November 2025; minutes are in the shared archive.
